title: Thorn and Spire Revisited
author: Jonah Delacroix
blurb: Felix Crane, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
